conclusion: At fixed selected weights, inference refinement changes macro Dice by only -0.0263pp (uncertain trained) and +0.0015pp (random trained/native random); no clear point refinement benefit.
Native uncertain refinement corrects92951 pixels but damages99475; raw point error enrichment did not demonstrate learned correction.
Swapping policies and two alternative random grids do not recover baseline validation best.
Selected coarse model differences already exist before refinement, but matched epoch4 baseline is weaker; cannot assert harmful point supervision from selected-epoch comparison.
Validation-only decomposition cannot attribute prior random-arm test gain to its inference mechanism.
action: Do not add more gates/modules or sweep point budgets on this evidence. Archive current joint PointRend adaptation as no validated improvement.
bounded_next_if_revisiting: Freeze selected strong baseline, train only native point MLP, compare no-refinement and uncertainty-refinement with identical baseline masks; stop family if point head adds no reproducible validation benefit.
